stem: In Q3 a business customer bought 40 monitors from Voltmarkt, listed at €250 each. The invoice price was €225 each. After the quarter, Voltmarkt paid the customer a volume rebate of €15 per monitor. Price realisation is 100 × what Voltmarkt keeps after on-invoice discounts and off-invoice rebates / list value. What was the price realisation on this sale? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
